newsitem.title: NORWAY: POLL-Norsk Hydro H197 seen slightly lower.
newsitem.headline: POLL-Norsk Hydro H197 seen slightly lower.

text.p: Norsk Hydro ASA is expected to post pre-tax profits of 6.09 billion crowns for the first half of 1997, a Reuters poll of nine Norwegian and international analysts showed.
The company booked profits before tax of 6.14 billion in the first six months 1996.
Two of the analysts recommended to buy the share, three said hold, three said sell and one declined to give a recommendation.

In the short-term, the analysts said they would be looking for volumes and margins in Hydro's agriculture division. Results in agriculture in the last two quarters have deviated widely from market expectations, coming in lower in the fourth quarter 1996 and above forecasts in the first quarter this year.

"The strong first quarter in agriculture indicates that it will continue," said one of the analysts. "It (the sector) recovered very strongly and I think that it will surprise the market again to the positive side."
Another said: "Sales won't be so large this time because the market has not been so good. However, better volumes and the fact that sales are in dollars will compensate."
Others said the results from the agricultural division in the first half would show the general pattern for the rest of the year.
"The question is whether Hydro has managed to hold up margins in agriculture. If it has, it is extremely encouraging," commented another analayst.
In the longer term, the company's international expansion would become the focus for investors, the analysts said, adding that Hydro's activities in Asia and South America could prove exciting.
"The most exciting area is the privatisation of the aluminium industry in Venezuela. Hydro's consortiun is one of the best," one of the international analysts said.
